# Lavatar

> Lavatar is an open-source deterministic WebGL2 avatar component for React and shadcn/ui.

## Links

- Playground: https://lavatar.sonarvue.com/
- Source: https://github.com/sonarvue/lavatar
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add sonarvue/lavatar/lavatar`
- Creator: https://www.sonarvue.com/

## Capabilities

- Generates the same animated avatar for the same seed.
- Runs locally with no image requests or stored avatar files.
- Supports lava, aurora, nebula, plasma, and monochrome palettes.
- Supports rounded, circular, and square shapes.
- Respects reduced-motion preferences and includes a CSS fallback.
